findings.issue: No test script, runner, or devDependency; the app has no test infrastructure at all, so npm test fails and future tests have nowhere to live
findings.suggestion: Add vitest for the pure data modules (api.ts, moves.ts) and a Playwright component/E2E config; wire a `test` script into package.json

findings.issue: Client-side sort uses `if (!a.v || !b.v)` so a data-value of "0" (e.g. a move learned at level 0) is sorted as missing and pushed last — a real bug an untested code path hides
findings.suggestion: Use `a.v === ''` as the missing check, and add a table-sort test with numeric 0 and missing values asserting 'missing sorts last, 0 sorts first ascending'

findings.issue: Default game = highest `order`, unknown-requested-game fallback, per-version-group dedup key, and method ordering are all untested core behavior
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getMoveTables against a small fixture: assert default selection, ?game= honored/rejected, level-up-then-name row order, and Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor-then-alpha table order

findings.issue: pokemonRefsToSpecies (alternate-form exclusion, dedup by id, dex-number sort, species-name resolution fallback) drives every 'Learned by'/'Pokémon' list and count; a refactor could reorder, duplicate, or leak forms with no failing test
findings.suggestion: Unit test with refs including IDs ≥10000, duplicates, and an id missing from the species index; assert ordering, dedup, and fallback naming

findings.issue: Filter matching, count text, and pagination clamp (page beyond totalPages → last page; NaN → 1) are untested URL-state logic
findings.suggestion: Integration tests for /?q=&type=&generation=&page=999: assert clamped page, matching count, and that pageHref drops default params

findings.issue: Localization helpers (humanize, latestEnglishFlavorText's \n/\f collapse, englishShortEffect's $effect_chance substitution, show()'s em-dash) are pure and trivially testable but unguarded
findings.suggestion: A handful of vitest cases with real-shaped fixtures (flavor text containing \f, effect_chance moves) would pin the spec's edge cases

findings.issue: The debounced search / DOMParser innerHTML-swap / popstate syncForm script is the most fragile code in the app and has no coverage; a selector or dataset rename silently breaks live filtering
findings.suggestion: A Playwright test typing in Search and asserting results update without Enter, plus back/forward navigation restoring state

findings.issue: getJson throws on non-404 errors, producing a raw 500 error page for every route; no test pins the intended failure mode
findings.suggestion: Decide on a graceful error/empty state and test the 5xx path once it exists

summary: The app ships with zero tests of its own and no test infrastructure — not even a `test` script — leaving every high-risk area (data mapping, sorting, filtering, pagination, URL state) protected only by the external acceptance suite. The untested code demonstrably hides real bugs, e.g. the client-side table sort treats a value of "0" as missing and sorts it last. Adding vitest for the two pure data modules plus a few Playwright interaction tests would cover nearly all of the risk at low cost.
